stops.name: Dachstein-Rieseneishöhle
stops.detail: The Dachstein-Rieseneishöhle is an ice cave in the Dachstein massif in the municipal area of Obertraun in the Upper Austrian part of the Salzkammergut. The total length of the cave, known so far, is 2700 m, of which 800 m are touristically developed as a show cave. Dachstein-Rieseneishöhle is an important tourist destination in Upper Austria, which receives around 150,000 visits annually.
